opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. Motion of petitioners for leave to file petition for writ of certiorari before judgment on 8V2- by 11-inch page proofs granted. Motion of respondents for leave to file brief in opposition on 8M2- by 11-inch page proofs granted. Motion of petitioners to expedite consideration of petition for writ of certiorari before judgment granted. Certiorari before judgment denied without prejudice.
